releaseNotes:
Is update mein kya naya hai:

1) Print ab gehra aur saaf - invoice ka har lafz aur table ki har line solid black. Pehle halke gray captions (shop ka address aur phone, BILL TO, Ph:, Cash, Prev. Balance, footer aur advertising line) laser print par tootte ya bilkul gayab ho jate the. PDF mein save karke print karne se bhi masla theek nahi hota tha, kyunki halka rang PDF ke andar hi baked hota hai.

2) A5 aur A4 ke font alag alag - A5 par kam se kam 8pt, to ek page par zyada items aate hain; A4 par 10 se 12pt. Shop ka naam 50% bara kiya gaya hai.

3) Urdu naam item ke saath ek hi line par - naya option 'Urdu Name on Same Line' (Template Settings). Default off hai, to purana andaz (Urdu neeche wali line par) waisa hi rehta hai.

4) SERVICES / SPARE PARTS ke group headers ab on ya off - naya option Template Settings mein. Aur services ki lines hamesha sab se aakhir mein chhapti hain, apne header ke saath.

5) Qty column - agar 'Show Extra Description' band ho to Qty ab center mein aata hai.

6) Thermal slip behtar - words ab gehre aur parhne mein aasan. Job Card ki tafseel ab alag box ki bajaye customer wale box ke andar aati hai, aur preview aur asli print dono bilkul ek jaise hain.

7) Har print size ka apna Shop Footer - A5, A4 aur Thermal ke liye alag alag footer likh sakte hain (Template Settings mein, upar se Template Type chun kar). Khali chhora to Shop Info wala purana footer hi chhapega.

8) Barcode label:
   - Size ab inch aur mm dono mein - 1.5x1 in, 2x1 in, 3x2 in, 4x2 in, 38x25 mm, 50x25 mm, 75x50 mm, 100x50 mm, ya Custom (in / mm).
   - Barcode ab label ki poori chaurai leta hai. Pehle wo label ki chauthai jagah bhi use nahi karta tha, is liye bars itni tang thi ke scanner aksar parh nahi pata tha.
   - Text label ke apne size ke hisab se bara, aur shop ka naam 12pt.
   - Aakhri baar jo label size aur up-count chuna tha wo agli baar khud select ho jata hai.

Update Date: 04-09-2026
